import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, MinMaxScaler
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures
from scipy.stats import linregress
import xgboost as xgb
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import warnings
import scipy

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
train_data_path = f"{input_dir}/train.csv"
test_data_path = f"{input_dir}/test.csv"
sample_submission_path = f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv"
submission_file = f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv"

os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_data_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_data_path)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Get feature names (exclude id and target from train, exclude id from test)
train_cols = set(train_df.columns.drop(["id", "target"]))
test_cols = set(test_df.columns.drop(["id"]))

# Find intersection of columns available in both datasets
common_features = sorted(list(train_cols.intersection(test_cols)))
print(f"Common features between train and test: {len(common_features)}")

# Keep only numeric features (float64 or int64)
numeric_features = [
    col for col in common_features if train_df[col].dtype in ["float64", "int64"]
]
print(f"Using {len(numeric_features)} numeric features: {numeric_features}")

# Extract raw numeric data
X_train_raw = train_df[numeric_features].astype(float).values
X_test_raw = test_df[numeric_features].astype(float).values

# Impute missing values with median
median_imputation = np.nanmedian(X_train_raw, axis=0)
X_train_filled = np.where(np.isnan(X_train_raw), median_imputation, X_train_raw)
X_test_filled = np.where(np.isnan(X_test_raw), median_imputation, X_test_raw)

# Apply logarithmic transformation for right-skewed features (improves convergence)
X_train_log = np.log(X_train_filled + 1e-10)
X_test_log = np.log(X_test_filled + 1e-10)

# Normalize using training statistics
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_normalized = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_log)
X_test_normalized = scaler.transform(X_test_log)

# Add polynomial interaction features (degree 2 captures linear + quadratic + interaction terms)
poly_features = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=False)
X_train_poly = poly_features.fit_transform(X_train_normalized)
X_test_poly = poly_features.transform(X_test_normalized)

print(f"Total features after polynomial expansion: {X_train_poly.shape[1]}")

# Target variable
y_train = train_df["target"].values

# Split data with stratification to preserve class distribution
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_poly,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train,
)

# Train XGBoost model
model_xgb = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="binary:logistic",
    n_estimators=800,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    min_child_weight=2,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    gamma=0.1,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1,
    eval_metric="auc",
    n_jobs=-1,
    tree_method="hist",
    verbosity=0,
    random_state=42,
)

model_xgb.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
y_xgb_train_pred = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_tr)[:, 1]
y_xgb_val_pred = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
xgb_val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_xgb_val_pred)

# Train LightGBM model
model_lgb = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="binary",
    num_leaves=63,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    n_estimators=800,
    max_depth=6,
    min_child_samples=20,
    bagging_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_freq=1,
    feature_fraction=0.8,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=True,
)

model_lgb.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
y_lgb_train_pred = model_lgb.predict_proba(X_tr)[:, 1]
y_lgb_val_pred = model_lgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
lgb_val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_lgb_val_pred)

# Ensemble weights based on validation performance
if lgb_val_auc > xgb_val_auc:
    alpha = lgb_val_auc / (lgb_val_auc + xgb_val_auc)
else:
    alpha = xgb_val_auc / (xgb_val_auc + lgb_val_auc)

y_ensemble_val_pred = alpha * y_lgb_val_pred + (1 - alpha) * y_xgb_val_pred
ensemble_val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_ensemble_val_pred)
print(f"Ensemble holdout validation AUC-ROC Score: {round(ensemble_val_auc, 4)}")

# Predict on full test set
y_test_xgb_pred = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_test_poly)[:, 1]
y_test_lgb_pred = model_lgb.predict_proba(X_test_poly)[:, 1]
y_test_ensemble_pred = alpha * y_test_lgb_pred + (1 - alpha) * y_test_xgb_pred

# Clip probabilities
y_test_ensemble_pred = np.clip(y_test_ensemble_pred, 0.0, 1.0)

# Create submission file
ids_list = test_df["id"].values
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df["target"] = y_test_ensemble_pred
submission_df.to_csv(submission_file, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {submission_file}")
print(f"Number of predictions in submission: {len(y_test_ensemble_pred)}")
print(f"Holdout validation AUC-ROC Score: {round(ensemble_val_auc, 4)}")
